_any_names: two helpers: one finds a field anywhere in a problem, the talent tests' only at its start
_band_top: three helpers on different things: a generated band, a drawn band, a stage's top in world pixels
_battle: three battle builders, each with its own heroes, monsters and placement
_check_fits: three checks of different things fitting: a hero window, the orders panel, the game's window
_count: counts of different things: the events heard, an events list, a journal sentence
_describe: three describers of different things: a level, an event as an array, an event as a string
_emit: each sends the events its spec's tests need, with its own arguments and age
_event: three event makers with different arguments and ticks
_guardian_fight: three different guardian fights: in the main scene, checked frame by frame, played for moves
_guardian_name: one names the guardian of a given depth, two that of their spec's guardian depth
_guardian_wipe: a wipe at the guardian in the main scene, and one on a bare HUD; they build different things
_hero: six helpers that find or make a hero from different things (index, class, id, save data, sprite)
_hero_def: the ability kit's hero has fewer fields set than the combat tests' one, which its tests rely on
_ids: ids of different things: fighters' ids, fighters' def ids, abilities' ids
_kinds: three helpers on different things: event kinds, events of a kind, content tables
_level: three ways to level a hero (with or without paragon spent) and one that returns a labyrinth level
_lose_next_fight: each loses a fight its own way: in the main scene, by stepping, by dooming the fight
_main: the main-scene fixture's laid-out Main, and two tests' own Main built on a save of their own
_monster: a monster sprite by id, the first monster id, the main scene's monster on show
_monster_def: the three test monsters differ in speed and the fields they set, which their tests rely on
_row: rows of different things: a shop row, a skill label, a main-scene shop row, the bar's buttons
_run: runs of different things: a battle, a sprite, ambience, the main scene's effects
_scripts: three listers of scripts with different roots and return types
_send: three different sends: the party to an area, the area map's go, an effect probe
_settle: settles different things: the stage list, the goals' celebration, the window settings
_settled: three main scenes settled for different things: the world, the bar, the bar with sound settings
_situation: each spec puts the expedition in the situation its tests need: different arguments and what it advances
_start: three main scenes started for different things: events heard, the moment, the milestones
_state: states of different things: the expedition, a ladder rung, a talent node
_tell: three helpers that tell events their own way: to the world, to an ability credit, to the status book
_texts: texts of different things: effect texts of a kind, a node's labels, the shown labels and buttons
_view: views of different things: the labyrinth, a talent tree, the camera's rect, a world with its HUD
_watch: watches different things: kills and drops, monster ids, the stage list's hint
_wipe: a wipe of the test's own party, of an optional one, of a given one
_world: each builds the world its tests need, with different settings and ambience
